nom: RODAN + FIELDS Redefine Daily Foaming Face Cleanser

segments.dry: Several reviewers describe their skin as dry and report the cleanser does not strip moisture and leaves skin soft rather than tight.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention aging or mature skin report the cleanser is gentle, non-exfoliating, and fits well into an anti-aging routine without irritation.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer with already dry, reactive skin values that it cleanses without stripping, and another notes it never irritates her skin when alternated with a clay cleanser.

concerns.aging: Reviewers focused on aging and mature skin report smoother, more even-toned, refreshed skin over years of use, with one crediting it for helping skin stay vibrant during aging; no negative effects on aging skin are mentioned.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the cleanser does not dry out skin and leaves it soft, moisturized or hydrated after use; no reviewer reports a drying effect, though one wishes the tube lasted longer given how much product she feels she needs.
concerns.redness: Only one reviewer directly addresses this, stating the cleanser never irritates her skin when rotated with the clay cleanser.

extraits.texte: It is usually creamy and foamy and now it seems like it has changed. . . it is gritty and I get it in my eyes and I don't like that feel.

I like this cleanser as it seems gentle on my skin, but it smells strongly like good old-fashion bar soap. I know it IS a form of soap, but the smell is just a bit off putting. I have used this product for years, I don't know if the formula has changed or why it's affecting me now, but that is the only thing I don't like about it. It works well.
Love the cleanser and use daily for past 10+ years. My skin's tone and clarity definitely is healthy and more even. I believe it is helping with keeping more vibrant during the aging process.
I love this cleanser and know I can trust products with the R&F label on it! My skin is already dry so I value a product that cleanses without stripping the moisture from my skin!
I have tried other products to test them out and always come back to my R&F products! Doesn't dry my skin out and leaves my face feeling clean.
I alternate tha foaming cleanser with the clay cleanser. It never irritates my skin!
Gentle, moisturizing product without concerning exfoliants for this aged skin
